item.title: Incarico post-doc: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 post-doc research contract - Department of History and Cultures (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-05 Sociologia generale

Title of the project:" The Historic City Centre in Transition: New Populations, Urban Practices, and Socio-Spatial Inequalities ". The research activity will focus on the design, implementation and analysis of a multidimensional study investigating the representations, perceptions and patterns of use of Bologna’s historic center, in support of the Integrated Strategy promoted by the Municipality of Bologna. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 post-doc research contract - Department of the Arts (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-06 Sociologia dei processi culturali e comunicativi

Title of the project:" Hostile Environments - London Research". As part of the ERC-funded research project ‘Hostile Environments: The Political Ecology of Migration and Border Violence’, this research will focus on forms of everyday bordering - mundane practices of exclusion, that make it impossible to live a normal life for those racialised as migrants, regardless of their juridical status or whether or not they have recently crossed international borders - in London, UK.
